title: Alchemy Books Table
html:
The Alchemy Books Table, also known as GEN_Book_Alchemy , is a leveled Treasure Table containing books on alchemy.

Drop table

Rolls 1-2 times on the Alchemy Books Table.

Quantity12
Chance 9/101/10
